subject: Post-discovery: lock demo window, loop security & procurement

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: lock demo window, loop security & procurement

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Goals: validate performance on your anonymized patient-retrieval flows and discuss SSO/entitlements.
- Suggested next meeting: 60–75m technical demo + ops Q&A where we bring a Redwood platform engineer (Markus) and someone from our security/compliance team.

I can offer these windows (PDT):
- Wed Oct 7, 10:00–11:15
- Thu Oct 8, 14:00–15:15
- Mon Oct 12, 09:00–10:15

If none of these work, tell me 2–3 times that do and I’ll lock the calendar. Please also confirm who from your side should join (engineering, CISO/procurement contact).

I attached the discovery notes from today for your reference (short summary + open questions).

Thanks — looking forward.

— Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (summary, 2 pages)

Thanks Aisha — appreciate the recap.

The slots on Oct 7 and Oct 8 look promising. Our key stakeholders are: 
- Engineering: myself and Dev Patel (dev.patel@vectrahealth.com)
- Procurement: Lisa Carter (cc'd)
- Security: our CISO (ciso@vectrahealth.com) — depending on availability they may send a delegate from security architecture.

Can you include a short demo agenda and any pre-reads for SOC2/Security evidence? Procurement will want to see retention and logging details.

Preferred slot: Thu Oct 8, 14:00–15:15 PDT. If you can lock that, we’ll confirm attendees on our side.

— Sam

Hi Sam — thanks for picking Thu 14:00. We’ll plan to run a focused technical demo + security Q&A. A few quick asks so we tailor the session:

1) Can you confirm whether the security attendee will be the CISO or a delegate from security architecture? If a delegate, please share their name/email so Markus can prep any architecture diagrams and threat-model notes.
2) Procurement: what level of commercial detail should we bring? (pricing band / licensing model or a high-level procurement path is usually enough for the first call).
3) Any required non-disclosure paperwork or PO templates we should expect from procurement ahead of time?

Priya — can you please send a calendar invite for Thu Oct 8 14:00–15:15 PDT and attach a short agenda (we’ll use the MMP-demo-agenda.docx). Markus, please include any security evidence pointers you want to surface; I flagged SOC2 and logging/retention as the main items.

Thanks — looking forward to this session.

— Marissa
